subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e8148a46464933702e8af69fb9325dee74232e84283a669771e106522adba6e.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

**There are three layer in block**

1) First layer transfer to second position.

2) Second layer transfer to third position.

3) Third layer transfer to first position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d210a1ad99b2d603d42adc0930d94fdeedc47c4f9228f842c8e5aa94dd7e65b0.png] 

And the sizes of the layers, follows:

small: top,bottom,middle

medium: middle,top,bottom

Large: bottom, middle, top

hence, in new figure: small on top, medium in middle and large in bottom (difference between option 1 and option 4)

**Hence, ‘option 1’ is the correct answer.**
